claims.assertion: Yazhi describes the Taygetan flagship as a 1,734-meter cruiser whose propulsion allows a non-disk hull.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan missions shifted from failed 1919/1952 government efforts to civilian spiritual outreach after governments sought military technology.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: The Federation First Contact Project used social media (2008–16) to test public readiness; it ended after finding little interest in contact.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She describes starseeds as souls incarnating, sometimes via avatar technology; Taygetan ships mainly guide them under nonintervention rules.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Some remember their origin; others do not.
